metadata.name: dig
metadata.description: Query DNS name servers (detailed DNS lookup)

installation.note: dig is provided by the dnsutils package on Debian/Ubuntu

overview.summary: dig (domain information groper) queries DNS servers and displays detailed results. It is more flexible and script-friendly than host or nslookup, showing response sections, flags, and timing.
when_to_use: Look up A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, or other DNS records
Debug DNS resolution or verify DNS configuration
Query a specific nameserver or record type

syntax.description: NAME is the domain to query. TYPE can be A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, etc. SERVER is the DNS server to query (optional).

options.description: Show only the answer section in a concise form
options.use_case: For scripting or quick one-line answers

options.description: Trace delegation from root servers (iterative resolution)
options.use_case: See how DNS resolution walks the hierarchy

options.description: Reverse DNS lookup (query PTR for an IP address)
options.use_case: Resolve an IP to a hostname

examples.title: Basic A record lookup
examples.description: Query default A and AAAA records for example.com
examples.use_case: Check what IP a domain resolves to

examples.title: Query MX records
examples.description: Get mail exchanger records for the domain
examples.use_case: Verify or debug email server configuration

related_commands.description: Simpler DNS lookup; less detailed than dig
